Senior/Staff ML Ops Engineer (Python Backend)

Engineering
Ahmedabad, Pune, Hyderabad
Share


About DataOrb

DataOrb is revolutionizing how organizations understand and utilize their customer data. We enable businesses of all sizes from ambitious startups to Fortune 500 companies to unlock insights from their customer interactions across conversational, transactional, and structured datasets. Founded by veterans from Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Samsung, were driven by a shared mission to democratize customer intelligence and make AI accessible to everyone.


The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly-skilled, experienced Engineering Manager to join our expanding Engineering team. You will be a part of the Applications team, primarily responsible for establishing the strategic technical direction, leading customer focus products and actively driving the execution of the strategy across many Dataorb s product areas taking care of the assignments and leading and managing the team related to transforming the designs into code. You should have a sense of design to point out the design gaps and give your valuable feedback to the design team. You will contribute to establish the best practices, follow them and motivate others as well to do the same. This role offers a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies applied to one-of-a-kind business problems. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, exceptional leadership skills, and a proven track record of managing high-performing engineering teams.


Core Responsibilities

Take complete ownership of delivery: Plan, track, and ensure the on-time delivery of high-quality software releases.
Plan sprints, allocate resources effectively, and manage team capacity to align with business priorities.
Act as a bridge between Product Owners, Stakeholders, and the Engineering team:
Engage regularly with the Product Owner to understand priorities, clarify requirements, and translate them into actionable technical tasks.
Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and blockers.
Drive continuous improvement in team processes, engineering standards, and best practices.
Mentor and coach team members, fostering growth in both technical and soft skills.
Lead performance reviews, goal-setting, and career development for engineers.
Promote a culture of ownership, accountability, and collaboration within the team.
Provide technical leadership: Guide the team on architecture, scalability, and performance optimization for Python-based backend services.

Review designs, code, and implementation for best practices, performance, and maintainability.
Contribute to PoCs, prototypes, and critical production features where needed.
Ensure code quality: Drive clean code principles, testing strategies, and observability standards.
Guide the team in solving complex engineering problems: database scaling, API performance, connection pooling, concurrency, and throughput.
Stay current with the latest Python trends and advocate for modern tools, frameworks, and practices.


Required Qualifications

10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on Python backend development
3+ years in a technical leadership or engineering management role
Strong team management skills: mentoring, delivery ownership, planning, stakeholder communication
Proven experience designing and delivering scalable, performant, and production-grade systems
Solid understanding of cloud architectures (AWS preferred), microservices, and SaaS platforms
Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and technical design skills
Passion for growing engineers, fostering a learning culture, and driving technical excellence.


Desired Experience

Background in working on SaaS products
Experience with AI/ML products
Exposure to event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SNS/SQS)
Familiarity with cost optimization and security best practices in AWS
Experience in start-up or SaaS product environments
Understanding of data pipelines and batch processing in large-scale systems
Experience in cost optimization and security best practices in cloud environments


Educational Requirements

Bachelors Or Master s degree in one of the following fields:
Bachelor of Computer Science
Bachelor of Engineering (Information Technology)
Masters of Computer Science
Master of Engineering (Information Technology)
OR
Equivalent professional experience in Backend Engineer (typically 5+ additional years of hands-on experience beyond the base requirement)


Technical Toolkit

Expert-level Python 3.12+ (or latest stable release)
Deep understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP), functional programming, and Python best practices (PEP8, type hints, async/await).
Microservices architecture: REST APIs, gRPC, API Gateway
PostgreSQL, MongoDB 7+: schema design, query optimization, data modeling
Cloud-native development with AWS: Lambda, SQS, SNS, RDS, DynamoDB, S3
Scalability and performance engineering: connection pooling, caching strategies, async frameworks (FastAPI, aiohttp).
Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and Kubernetes (1.29+) for deployment and orchestration.
Testing best practices: pytest, unittest, mocking, integration testing.
Exposure to MLOps and ML model integration is a plus: SageMaker, MLflow, TensorFlow, PyTorch.


Why Join DataOrb

Mission: Be part of democratizing customer intelligence and making AI accessible
Impact: Shape how organizations understand and serve their customers
Team: Work with experienced leaders from top tech companies
Growth: Rapid scaling environment with significant learning opportunities
Culture: Autonomous, trust-based environment focused on outcomes
Benefits:
Flexible work arrangements
Comprehensive health coverage
Generous PTO policy
Professional development support
Competitive compensation package


Our Values

Customer Obsession: We practice what we preach
Democratizing Technology: Making complex solutions accessible
Innovation with Purpose: Solving real customer problems
Trust and Autonomy: Freedom to create and deliver excellence
